supersedes: Additive producer provenance overlay for market-channel.v1; operation_id retains canonical coins/markets semantics. Existing formulas, consumer groups, topic and root-record shape remain unchanged.

producers.name: coingecko.coins_markets
producers.note_zh: 沿用现有采集范围；本批不改变市值门槛，也不将它改成排除股票的Crypto专用任务。
producers.note_en: Keep the existing scope and cap threshold; this is not a new stock-excluding Crypto collector.

producers.name: coingecko.stocks.token_markets
producers.note_zh: 完整分页发现tokenized-stock成员，不设价格/市值门槛；采集保留不代表达到榜单资格。
producers.note_en: Discover all tokenized-stock pages without a price/cap floor; retention does not imply board eligibility.

fields.rule_zh: CoinGecko稳定coin ID；不能用symbol代替。
fields.rule_en: Stable CoinGecko coin ID; never substitute symbol.

fields.rule_zh: 原样保留，不用于身份合并。
fields.rule_en: Preserve; not an identity key.

fields.rule_zh: 上游名称，不用于身份合并。
fields.rule_en: Upstream name; not an identity key.

fields.rule_zh: USD价格；缺失保持null，非正数不可进入现有榜单。
fields.rule_en: USD price; preserve null. Existing boards require positive values.

fields.rule_zh: 代币市值，非公司市值；采集不以正市值为过滤条件。
fields.rule_en: Token capitalization, not company capitalization; no positive-cap collection filter.

fields.rule_zh: 滚动24小时USD成交额；不能累加快照当增量。
fields.rule_en: Rolling-24h USD volume; never sum snapshots as incremental turnover.

fields.rule_zh: 百分点：12表示12%；缺失保持null。
fields.rule_en: Percentage points: 12 means 12%; preserve null.

fields.rule_zh: 上游更新时间；不能用采集时间补齐，缺失明确无效。
fields.rule_en: Source update time; never fill with collection time. Null is explicitly invalid.

fields.rule_zh: 兼容既有顶层字段，必须等于meta.collected_at。
fields.rule_en: Legacy root field; must equal meta.collected_at.

fields.rule_zh: 两路固定coingecko.coins_markets：同一接口语义，不是采集任务名。
fields.rule_en: Both use coingecko.coins_markets for the same API semantics, not the collector identity.

fields.rule_zh: 2010=coingecko.coins_markets；2051=coingecko.stocks.token_markets。
fields.rule_en: 2010=coingecko.coins_markets; 2051=coingecko.stocks.token_markets.

fields.rule_zh: 2010=default_market；2051=tokenized_stocks。描述任务范围，不是全局资产类别。
fields.rule_en: 2010=default_market; 2051=tokenized_stocks. A collection scope, not a global asset class.

fields.rule_zh: 每个任务每轮一个不同UUID；所有分页及重试沿用。
fields.rule_en: Distinct UUID per collector execution; reuse across pages and retries.

fields.rule_zh: 共同调度生成；两路同轮共用；迟到数据仍属于原轮次。
fields.rule_en: Scheduler-owned shared round UUID; late data retains its original round.

fields.rule_zh: UUIDv5(namespace=source_run_id,name=coin ID)；相同ID不同内容拒绝覆盖。
fields.rule_en: UUIDv5(namespace=source_run_id,name=coin ID); reject differing content under one ID.

fields.rule_zh: 共同轮次计划启动UTC时间，不是已完成截止时间。
fields.rule_en: Shared scheduled UTC start, not a completed comparison cutoff.

fields.rule_zh: 本条所在分页的实际请求UTC时间；重试发布不改写。
fields.rule_en: Actual UTC request time for this record page; publication retries preserve it.

fields.rule_zh: 该原始响应首次接收UTC时间；等于顶层collected_at。
fields.rule_en: First receipt time of the original response; equal to root collected_at.

fields.rule_zh: 本合同固定usd；不同报价不可共用历史。
fields.rule_en: Fixed usd; different currencies cannot share a history series.

fields.rule_zh: 2010=coingecko.default_market.v1；2051=coingecko.tokenized_stocks.v1。成员资格规则变更换版本，不按轮次换。
fields.rule_en: 2010=coingecko.default_market.v1; 2051=coingecko.tokenized_stocks.v1. Version membership rules, not rounds.

fields.rule_zh: 可回查完整请求、分页响应及行位置的持久引用；示例fixture引用不是真实存储。
fields.rule_en: Durable full-request/page-response/row reference; fixture examples are not real storage.

fields.rule_zh: healthy/missing/invalid/conflict；只说明单条质量，不能证明本轮完整。
fields.rule_en: healthy/missing/invalid/conflict: record quality does not establish round completeness.

fields.rule_zh: 指向本任务本轮完成报告；发布时报告可仍pending，消费时必须回查完成态。
fields.rule_en: Reference the collector-run coverage report; may be pending at publication, must be resolved by consumers.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 固定coingecko.coins_markets；接口语义，采集任务另由collector_id标识。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Fixed canonical API operation coingecko.coins_markets; collector_id identifies the task.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 独立采集运行，与消息source_run_id一致。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Collector execution ID, equal to message source_run_id.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 保留现有采集质量状态枚举；健康完整报告用healthy，不能用complete替代旧状态值。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Retain the existing quality enum; healthy complete reports use healthy, not complete.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 实际成功分页数；不能据第一页面推断全量。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Actual successful page count; first page is not proof of coverage.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 完整采集按coin ID去重后的数量；失败/未知为null而不是0。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Unique coin count for complete collection; failure/unknown is null, not zero.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 完整分页清单、终止依据、重复/冲突和错误明细的持久引用。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Durable page manifest, termination evidence, duplicates/conflicts and error details.
Actual completion time; null when pending.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 失败、缺口与冲突原因；不得伪造成功。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Failure, gaps and conflicts; do not fabricate success.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 新增独立完成状态；缺页、429未恢复、超时不可complete。只有round_status=complete且status=healthy才是健康完整轮次。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Separate completion state; gaps, unrecovered 429 and timeout cannot be complete. Require round_status=complete AND status=healthy.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 本任务本轮第一次实际请求UTC时间。
coverage_fields.rule_en: UTC time of the first actual request in this collector run.

coverage_fields.rule_zh: 沿用原首次完整导入/跟踪规则，不因新增Stocks重置默认行情基线。
coverage_fields.rule_en: Retain existing first-import/tracking semantics; adding Stocks does not reset default-market baseline.

rules_zh: Header只识别共用CoinGecko行情语义；不使用卡号作运行身份，不增加市场分类Header。meta.collector_id+source_run_id区分任务和执行；operation_id归一接口语义。任务、范围和coverage_key必须与固定注册项成组匹配，未知或不匹配消息隔离。
两路消息都保留原始单coin行情在Value根层；采集器meta不是CoinGecko接口原生返回。顶层collected_at与meta.collected_at一致。其他上游字段沿用原transform，不在本批重定义；缺失可选字段保持null或缺失，不能填零。
UTC时间要求scheduled_at<=requested_at<=collected_at；可解析的last_updated<=collected_at。当前15分钟新鲜度和指标数值资格沿用各消费者合同。缺失元数据不可套默认2010或健康状态，也不得用接收时间伪造上游时间。
重试同一source_observation_id保留消息内容、时间和原始引用；不同内容构成冲突，隔离而不覆盖。不同任务有不同run/observation ID，但共用coingecko_coin_id命名空间，不重复建档。
历史匹配仍要求相同operation_id/source_id、稳定coin ID、USD与coverage_key；仅任务名不同不改接口语义，同任务范围改变需新coverage版本。不得混合两路coverage历史或用2010历史静默补2051的RVOL。只有独立批准的历史兼容/重建方案才能跨范围复用。
同一资产由两任务发现：保留两份采集出处；同一策略和rule_version对同一operation_id+coin ID+报价+last_updated至多接受一个事件。相同上游时间但价格/成交额等不一致标为conflict，不任选一条计分。不同上游时间是不同真实观测。缺失上游时间不可生成该业务去重键。

原Crypto榜继续使用default_market候选池；股票任务不自动加入该榜。Stocks独立榜选tokenized_stocks。未来混合榜按共同round_id和两份完整coverage报告冻结round_cutoff=max(completed_at)，对每个coin选截止前最新有效观测：observed_at降序、collected_at降序、observation_id升序，前提是重叠报价无冲突；每资产只一条，不直接比较不同cohort算出的相对分数。

覆盖报告由现有#1014覆盖职责承载的逻辑设计，不新建业务Topic/表。每条quality_status=healthy不表示全轮complete；pending/partial/failed不可发布完整榜单或移除旧成员。新鲜度过期则本轮不可发布；不回退上一轮充数。 原status=healthy/missing/partial/unknown不变，新增round_status区分完成态；只有status=healthy且round_status=complete并有完整分页证据才可认定健康完整。
#3035同一程序消费两路，按任务/范围分组检查并只查询已有身份；source_only仍可计算，缺历史保留null和原因。#3041按observation_id汇总并核对来源、轮次、范围及身份快照，collector_id/round_id/collection_scope/coverage_ref随指标保留到#5007。指标版本/空身份/历史不足处理沿用现有合同。
生产/测试周期沿用实际配置。本设计不保证同时启动等于同时返回；3分钟配置不代表3分钟可完整采完。Few实际注册、消息、完成报告存储/通知、调度、消费与幂等落地均未验证。
rules_en: Headers route shared CoinGecko market semantics. collector_id plus source_run_id identify the collector execution; operation_id identifies canonical API semantics. Reject unknown or mismatched collector/scope/coverage tuples.

Preserve the per-coin raw record at the Value root. Collector-owned meta is not native CoinGecko output; root and meta collected_at must agree. Existing transforms and optional-field rules remain unchanged.

Require scheduled_at <= requested_at <= collected_at and parseable source time <= collected_at. Preserve existing 15-minute freshness and numeric eligibility. Never default missing provenance to collector 2010 or invent source time.

Retries reuse the observation ID and frozen content/times/references; differing content is a conflict. Different collectors have separate run/observation IDs but reuse the coingecko_coin_id identity namespace.

History still matches canonical source, stable coin ID, USD and coverage_key. Do not silently use default-market history to fill Stocks RVOL; cross-coverage reuse needs separately approved compatibility/rebuild rules.

Preserve both collection origins. Accept at most one event per rule/version and canonical source+coin+currency+source timestamp; conflicting quote values at that timestamp are quarantined. Different source times are distinct observations.

Existing Crypto boards retain default_market. Stocks boards use tokenized_stocks. Any future mixed board freezes a shared round only after both complete reports; cutoff=max(completed_at). Keep one latest valid row per coin, sort source time descending, receipt time descending, observation ID ascending, and reject quote conflicts before selection. Do not merge cohort-relative scores.

The logical report belongs to existing #1014 coverage responsibilities; physical storage is unverified. A healthy row is not a complete round. Pending/partial/failed/stale rounds cannot publish a complete ranking or remove old members; never substitute previous rounds. Preserve existing status enum; add round_status. Require status=healthy and round_status=complete with a complete page manifest.

The shared Polars program validates and groups by provenance, only looks up identity, and preserves missing history. Assembly joins by observation_id and checks provenance/identity consistency; carry collector_id/round_id/collection_scope/coverage_ref to indicator.data without changing metric versions.

Actual environment cadence remains unchanged. Scheduling every 3 minutes does not prove pagination finishes in 3 minutes. Few registry, publishing, reports, scheduling, consumers and durable idempotency remain unverified.
overlap_rules_zh: 业务重复键相同但共享报价字段不同即冲突；可选未请求字段不参与报价冲突比较。消息重试则仍要求整个原始消息冻结一致。
